task_completion.description: Open the specified PDF file in a Firefox tab.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A Firefox tab showing 'Heavy_Scientific_Report.pdf' rendered in the built-in PDF viewer.

task_completion.description: Navigate to the about:memory page in a new tab.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A Firefox tab with 'about:memory' in the address bar and the memory troubleshooting interface visible.

task_completion.description: Click the GC and CC buttons to clear memory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the cursor interacting with 'GC' and 'CC' buttons under the 'Free memory' section, or status messages indicating they were triggered.

task_completion.description: Save the baseline memory report with the specific filename 'memory_baseline.json.gz'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file save dialog with 'memory_baseline.json.gz' typed into the filename field, followed by a save confirmation.

task_completion.description: Scroll through at least 20 pages of the PDF to increase memory usage.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The PDF tab showing rapid scrolling or a page indicator (e.g., '25 / 100') significantly higher than the initial page.

task_completion.description: Save the peak memory report as 'memory_peak.json.gz' without triggering GC/CC first.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file save dialog with 'memory_peak.json.gz' typed into the filename field. The VLM must verify no GC/CC buttons were clicked between scrolling and this save.

integrity.description: The agent used the Firefox GUI and file dialogs rather than terminal commands to create the files.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements and typing within the Firefox browser and system file picker, not a terminal window.

integrity.description: The agent manually entered the required filenames instead of accepting defaults.
integrity.visual_evidence: The file save dialog shows the specific requested filenames being typed or present, which differ from the default 'memory-report.json.gz' format.

integrity.description: The agent actually interacted with the PDF content to cause bloat.
integrity.visual_evidence: Visual confirmation of the PDF scrollbar moving or page numbers changing in the Firefox UI.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The default filename for Firefox memory reports is usually 'memory-report.json.gz' or includes a timestamp. The task specifically requires 'memory_baseline.json.gz' and 'memory_peak.json.gz'. The 'GC' and 'CC' buttons are located in the 'Free memory' box on the about:memory page. To verify the 20-page scroll, look at the page counter in the PDF toolbar.
